(8 goals) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = 116 | total goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2017 Ghanaian Premier League|2017]] | nextseason = [[2019 Ghanaian Premier League|2019]] | updated = 30 December 2018 | extra information = The League was cancelled in June 2018 due to GFA scandal }} The '''2018 [[Ghanaian Premier League]]''' was the 62nd season of top professional [[association football]] in [[Ghana]]. The season was initially scheduled to begin on 11 February 2018, but was postponed to 4 March 2018,{{cite web|url=http://ghanafa.org/index/league_news_details/3/12651|title=2017/2018 Premier League season to kick off on March 3|publisher=Ghana Football Association|date=21 February 2018}} and later postponed indefinitely.{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/soccer/ghana/story/3401373/ghana-premier-league-postponed-indefinitely|title=Ghana Premier League postponed indefinitely|publisher=ESPNFC|date=1 March 2018}} It was then scheduled to begin on 17 March 2018.{{cite web|url=http://www.ghanafa.org/news/full_news/16/12679|title=2017/18 Division One League to kick off next weekend|publisher=Ghana Football Association|date=15 March 2018}}[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/gha2018.html Ghana 2018], rsssf.org The league kicked off on 17 March with a match between [[International Allies F.C.|Inter-Allies]] vs [[Bechem United F.C.|Bechem United]] in Tema.
